verdict.rationale: Modal documents Sandboxes as isolated, ephemeral containers built for untrusted user or agent code. It also offers network egress controls (block_network, outbound allowlists) that limit what agent code can reach. However, the evidence never explicitly says that host or account secrets and credentials are unreachable from inside a sandbox, so the specific secret-isolation guarantee is implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that host and platform secrets and credentials are inaccessible to sandboxed code, details of the isolation boundary (VM Sandboxes appear only as a Beta heading), and independent or hands-on corroboration of credential isolation.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can give an agent a sandbox where host secrets and credentials are unreachable by the code it runs
